flags.why: The expression ong bướm describes flirting or womanizing, but bướm alone does not mean a flirtatious or promiscuous person.
Đề commonly means to start a vehicle's engine using its starter, a frequent everyday use missing here.
flags.fix: verb | to start an engine using the starter; ex: Tôi đề máy mãi mà xe không nổ. = I kept trying to start the engine, but it wouldn't start.

flags.why: Nghịch means inverse or opposite; the full expression tỉ lệ nghịch means inversely proportional.
